court.name: High Court of Madhya Pradesh at Jabalpur

summary: In April 2016, one person was accused of the aggravated penetrative assault on a child in Mandla, Madhya Pradesh. The charges also include kidnapping, abduction and procuring a minor. Police have filed a chargesheet. The accused was acquitted. An appeal against the acquittal has been filed. Identifying details are withheld by law (POCSO s.23).
title: Aggravated penetrative assault on a child — Mandla (2016) — acquitted
